name: tou_away_heat_bank_surfaces_1404

assertions.reason: First classified cycle inside the bank window: the thermostat is told the bank target 63°F once (Issues #1393/#1395 unchanged by #1404).
Nothing is written between cycles (the bank write cancels the 5-minute follow-up; the bank check sees the thermostat holds it).
The next cycle re-asserts the bank target once.

The heat/cool thresholds (ca_target_heat/cool, the Heat/Cool Threshold sensors, the reading card's 'Climate Advisor wants') quote the bank: the heat edge is 63°F, what the thermostat is told (issue #1404).
The threshold sensors' context names the time-of-use bank.
The chart draws the same band the thresholds quote (issue #1404).

description: Issue #1404 (Away heat): an empty house on a cold day with a 16:15-21:00 peak (Away band 60-80 F). The split-delta bank tells the thermostat heat 63 F. Before the fix Status, the thresholds and the briefing quoted heat 60 F, the chart drew 60-63 F, Next Automation said 'No more actions today' and the plan list called the band 'the away band'.
notes: Issue #1537 (owner-approved golden change; re-derived 2026-11-13, owner approved: harness thermostats report hvac_action (#1537)): decisions and service calls are unchanged; only incident_detected.thermostat_action changed (None -> off). (a) Effectiveness: unchanged, no decision, service call, assertion or promise outcome moved. (b) Docs<->production: docs/sim-harness-spec.md (#1537 default reporting). (c) Occupant: nothing the occupant sees changed; the golden now runs on a thermostat that reports its equipment like a real one.

verdict.summary: While an empty house pre-heats for a peak, every surface says it is held to 63 F and when the widened Away band takes over
verdict.observed_behavior: The thermostat is told 63°F once per cycle; Status, the thresholds, the briefing, the chart band, Next Action, Next Automation and the plan list all quote 63°F and the band that follows.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: the person can read on any surface what the house is held to during the bank and when it goes back.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 6ebdb16 (before #1404): Next Action and Next Automation differ by value; the hold.* rows fail because 6ebdb16 has no current_hold (its thresholds quoted the schedule band, here 60/80, and the chart drew the #786 shape). Deleting the display resolver (current_hold) fails every field_equals here; the setpoint_writes rows pin that the thermostat writes did not change.
verdict.alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md (time-of-use bank, Issue #1404 paragraph) and docs/scheduler-spec.md describe the same hold sentence and band.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, the person checking on the empty house would read a band the thermostat is not told (e.g. 'Climate Advisor wants 60 F' while it heats to 63 F) and could not tell what the house is held to or when it goes back.
